heading: Describe your automation
intro: Tell me what you want. I'll propose a plan, then ask you to choose the templates, audiences and variable mappings — so the workflow that lands is ready to publish.
goalPlaceholder: e.g. 3 days after someone fills the JEE lead form, if they haven't enrolled, WhatsApp them the brochure.

decisions.heading: A few choices only you can make:
decisions.noVariables: This template has no variables to map — nothing to do here.

templateSelect.noneFoundWhatsapp: No WhatsApp templates found — create one in Settings → Templates first.
templateSelect.noneFoundEmail: No email templates found — create one in Settings → Templates first.
